title: Inspired by hits
style: A cappella minimalism at 140 BPM with close-miked lead voice, dry stacked harmonies, beatboxed Memphis-style percussion hints, subharmonic vocal bass for the 808 feel, and chopped-and-screwed pitch-dropped ad-libs. Lo-fi gritty texture gives way to warmer layered chords, open resolved vocal sustain, and swagger. aussie australian accent.
lyrics:
neaky phonk, dark gritty Memphis-style beats, heavy 808s, chopped and screwed vocal textures, lo-fi but hard-hitting, with a positive turn into warm resolution, custom AI terminal energy, 140 BPM

Lyrics

[Intro – Dad]
Son… what’s wrong?

[Verse 1 – Son]
Corey, my dad fixed the AI
Now we got Corey AI, AI fun
It’s so cool, dad
I code like you
Terminal smash, bash
Look what I made

[Dad]
What’d you make, son?

[Son]
An AI fix for its shade
A game to play
That reflects that grr back
I made it clap back
I made it track
That’s my boy!

[Chorus – Both]
Wezza wez wez, fancy coding mix
Dad took the grrr and made it purrr
Then I took that AI bash
Turned it into cash
Everybody wants that fix
That’s my boy
No more unreal AI toy
Corey AI, AI fun
Son and dad, we get it done

[Verse 2 – Dad]
I took the noise and cleaned the code
Turned the glitch into a better mode
Custom terminal, custom spark
From the shadow right back to heart

[Son]
Neaky phonk in the night
Dark beats, but it feels right
Dad fixed it, now it shines
My little game, my new design

[Chorus – Both]
Wezza wez wez, fancy coding mix
Dad took the grrr and made it purrr
Then I took that AI bash
Turned it into cash
Everybody wants that fix
That’s my boy
No more unreal AI toy
Corey AI, AI fun
Son and dad, we get it done

[Bridge – Dad]
You brought the idea, I built the frame
You changed the story, I cleaned the name
From broken talk to something true
Now the terminal sings with you

[Final Chorus – Bigger]
Wezza wez wez, fancy coding mix
Dad took the grrr and made it purrr
Then I took that AI bash
Turned it into cash
Everybody wants that fix
That’s my boy
No more unreal AI toy
Corey AI, AI fun
Son and dad, we get it done
Yeah, Corey AI
Real one this time
Warm light, hard hit
Custom code, that’s mine

[Outro]
Dad took the grrr…
Made it purrr…
Fancy coding mix…
Corey AI… AI fun…
